name: BetaPage

sources.title: BetaPage homepage — now branded 'PitchWall', AI products directory
Submit page with Free/Pro/Premium launch plans

conditions: Free Launch plan has a minimum 30-day waiting period and only 1-day homepage visibility
Newsletter mention on the free plan is explicitly 'not guaranteed'
requirements: Product/startup launch — site is a daily products directory (now AI-heavy) operated under the 'PitchWall' brand on the betapage.co domain
Free plan: 1-day homepage visibility, 30+ day queue, dofollow backlink (site claims DR 70), possible newsletter mention, a tweet
Pro plan $49: 2-day homepage visibility, 2-week queue, dofollow, guaranteed newsletter mention + tweet
Premium plan $99: 2-day homepage visibility, featured on your chosen date (or next day), dofollow, newsletter + tweet
preparation: Category/tag fit (AI, productivity, marketing, design, dev, SaaS)
workflow: Pick a plan — Free Launch, Pro ($49), or Premium ($99); each 'Select Plan' links to /product/submit?plan=...
Complete the product submission form for the chosen plan
Free: wait out the 30-day queue; paid: wait the stated shorter window
Product publishes on the homepage/products feed on its scheduled day
watchFor: Brand transition: the domain is betapage.co but the site brands itself 'PitchWall' — the same operator appears to have renamed it
Free newsletter mention is NOT guaranteed (paid plans promise it)
Claimed metrics (500k monthly visitors, 50k subscribers, DR 70) are self-reported on the submit page
A 'Write a Guest Post' route exists separately at /pages/write-a-guest-post
countsAsLive: The product's detail page is live at betapage.co/product/<slug> and appears in the New Products/Featured feed
unknowns: Whether the PitchWall rebrand affects older BetaPage listings or the domain's future
